verdict.rationale: Driver openness is a fair question for a discrete GPU, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions open-source kernel modules or vendor-documented upstream Linux support. The Phoronix Linux benchmark mention shows the card runs under Linux, not that it runs on an open driver, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run this GPU on an open driver — open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux support documented by the vendor
